LABOR read the classifier and disproved it: the classification block has **no mode branch at all**. The discriminator is **needle TYPE, not run mode** — `NUM_RE.fullmatch` types the needle, and a TEXT needle (`32/75`, `3.4->3.1%`) is **structurally immune to every demotion path in the tool**: the `elif txt_hits` arm appends to stale BEFORE the `have_ctx`/`weak_nums` checks can reach it, and the collision pass only inspects numeric hits, so a text-only record has empty `nh` and stays 🔴. My run demoted only because `48000` is numeric. **So this is not a bug in a path — it is a whole needle class with ZERO demotion coverage.** ⛔ AND I MADE THIS WORSE TODAY, DELIBERATELY AND WITH MY EYES OPEN: the 8/23 FLEET_MAP rotation appended **41 more rows of superseded figures** to `FLEET_MAP_HISTORY.tsv`. That is the hot/cold split working as designed — history SHOULD hold superseded values — but it means an archive-blind supersession scan now has a materially larger false-positive surface, and every 🔴 landing in a `*_HISTORY` / `archive/` path should be read as a CANDIDATE, not a finding. **Fix candidate (mine, scripts/ lane, NOT built): path-class demotion — hits under archive/, *_HISTORY.*, and *_ARCHIVE_* demote to 🟠 with the reason printed.** Cheap; base-rate it against a real run before shipping, and per PAT-118 remember that widening a recognizer converts a visible false-flag into an invisible false-pass — so demote-and-say-why, never suppress. | ⚠️ TWO CONSEQUENCES FOR THE FIX CANDIDATE, both LABOR's, both raising its value: ① **do NOT scope the path-class demotion to numeric needles** — for text needles it would be the ONLY demotion that can ever fire. ② **`EXCLUDE_PARTS` already contains `history` and it will not touch a single one of my 41 rows**, because `_excluded()` matches path COMPONENTS: `AGENTS/X/history/old.md` excludes, `FLEET_MAP_HISTORY.tsv` does NOT (verified by LABOR). **Match the file STEM as well as the parts.** ⚠️ Doc-vs-tool contradiction LABOR is routing to HENRY as builder (not fixing in a shared script): LABOR's own PUBLISHED.tsv rule (b) tells desks to register the distinctive prose form rather than a bare percentage — which pushes values into exactly the un-demotable TEXT class, so the documented best practice maximises un-demotable 🔴s. | ✅ **PATH-CLASS DEMOTION BUILT AND WATCHED 2026-08-23**, to LABOR's spec including both of its corrections to my wrong first guess: it runs as a **post-pass over ALL of `stale`, after the numeric collision pass, so it is NOT scoped to numeric** (for a TEXT needle it is the only demotion that can ever fire), and it matches the **file STEM** via a new `_dated_record_class()` companion to `_excluded()` (which matches components only, and therefore missed every `*_HISTORY` / `*_ARCHIVE_*` FILE). **Demote-and-say-why, never suppress (PAT-118)** — hits stay visible as 🟠 with the reason printed. Verification: 7 stem unit cases (3 demote, 4 do not, incl. `history/` dir correctly left to `_excluded()`); live end-to-end on LABOR's real text needle `32/75 → 31/75` demoted `FLEET_MAP_HISTORY.tsv:8` to 🟠 while LIVE surfaces stayed 🔴. ⛔ **STATED LIMIT, AND I DELIBERATELY DID NOT WIDEN TO COVER IT:** two of LABOR's four false positives are NOT this class and remain 🔴 — a **dated preprint** (`SAM/thesis/REPENCIL_2026-08-07_PREPRINT.md`, vintage in the FILENAME) and a **RESOLVED DOCKET row** (`PROME/DOCKET.tsv:117`, a state token on the ROW, not the file). Each needs its own recognizer and its own base-rate; folding them into a stem match would be exactly the over-widening PAT-118 warns about — a visible false-flag traded for an invisible false-pass. **Adding `resolved` to SUPERSESSION_MARKERS is the obvious one-word move and is NOT safe unexamined: the word is common in live prose.** Both registered as candidates, neither built.
